The outer waiver arm contains exactly command, the inner rosters/counts are frozen and bounded, and any humanApprovalRef, waiverRef, project, principal, time, step-up or mixed legacy field refuses as POLICY_WAIVER_PAYLOAD_INVALID at literal DAEMON_POLICY_WAIVER before store reads.

In daemon-command-registry.ts detect only the exact SOFT_POLICY_WAIVER arm before the ordinary approval.decide operator gate. Admit the configured operator or a production isDurableHumanPrincipal only with authenticated ADMIN capability; use exact POLICY_WAIVER_HUMAN_REQUIRED / POLICY_WAIVER_ADMIN_REQUIRED provenance for this branch, while the same paired principal presenting legacy approval.decide still refuses OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_REQUIRED at DAEMON_AUTHORIZATION.

Mint HumanReviewWitness from the authenticated principal+command id inside that admitted branch. Derive the one-use stepUpAuthRef with sessionReplayDigest using generation 0 and an approval.decide/SOFT_POLICY_WAIVER tag bound to the ledger aggregate/tuple; never reuse the run-scoped approval.decide_intent tag and never accept a caller step-up value.

For GRANT, require explicit canonical expiry strictly after decidedAt and no more than 24 hours later; build server-owned refs/record and append it at the envelope expectedVersion. For REVOKE, fold the same aggregate, resolve the current exact-tuple grant, and append its tombstone. Atomically commit the waiver event and buildReplayMarkerDecisionLeg in one store decision, so refusal/version conflict/replay writes neither and a successful request cannot reuse its step-up.

Focused tests drive createDaemonCommandPorts through the production registry and pin HTTP human success, exact output/ledger bytes, GRANT->superseding GRANT->REVOKE, missing/current-version/race/replay failures, ADMIN and durable-human fences, legacy-branch divergence, and bidirectional MCP exclusion. Generated payload/refusal rosters assert exact nonzero counts; loosening the human fence or atomic replay-marker leg makes its named production-surface assertion red, then tracked restore is proven.

planningNotes.risks:
Do not bind to the prerequisite's present untracked WIP or invent an export name. After task-ec83 is DONE, read its completionSummary, reviewSummary, verification, and landed public bridge; if it does not expose an authoritative exact codec, aggregate/tuple identity, current-state fold, and expected-version decision-leg builder sufficient for this row, report blocked on that concrete missing surface instead of shadowing it.
Exact decoder order matters: validate outer/inner shape before isDurableHumanPrincipal or any other store read. For divergence, a durable HUMAN with planning.write but no ADMIN must reach only POLICY_WAIVER_ADMIN_REQUIRED; a non-HUMAN principal with planning.write+ADMIN must reach only POLICY_WAIVER_HUMAN_REQUIRED; the same paired HUMAN with legacy bytes must still reach only OPERATOR_PRINCIPAL_REQUIRED at DAEMON_AUTHORIZATION.
Perform decision-ledger idempotency identification before rebuilding/folding the waiver leg. Otherwise a byte-identical retry with the old expectedVersion can be falsely rejected after the aggregate advances. Include expectedVersion in deterministic request bytes, distinguish changed-byte idempotency conflict, waiver-leg version race, and marker-leg replay by exact code and layer.
Canonical expiry requires new Date(parsed).toISOString() === supplied text, strictly decidedAt < expiry <= decidedAt+24h, and one captured clock value. The replay nonce must use generation 0 and the literal approval.decide/SOFT_POLICY_WAIVER tag plus the prerequisite's aggregate and exact tuple identities; never accept or expose a caller step-up reference.
Shared checkout dirt is foreign. Touch only the five named paths. Before mutations record exact-path status; for any untracked new path use an out-of-tree %TEMP% backup and a separate post-restore SHA256 equality check. For tracked paths compare the pre/post mutation diff. Never stash, reset, or stage broadly.
